summary: The Bureau of Reclamation generally concurred with the adequacy of the Draft Environmental Statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644. However, it recommended that Subsection III of the operating criteria on noise control be strengthened by replacing the vague phrase 'unusual or excessive noise' with more definitive provisions to ensure reasonably uniform application.

statement.text:
United States Department of the Interior
BUREAU OF RECLAMATION 
WASHINGTON, D.C. 20240
IN REPLY 420 REFER TO: 120.1
JUL7 1572
Memorandum
To:
Director, Bureau of Outdoor Recreation
From:
Commissioner, Bureau of Reclamation
Subject: Draft Environmental Statement for the Proposed
Implementation of Executive Order 11644
Responsive to your memorandum of June 1, 1972, the subject statement has been distributed in accordance with the Secretary's notice of availability dated May 26, 1972.
Responses from review in this office and our field offices indicated general concurrence relative to adequacy of the subject statement. We suggest, however, that further consideration be given to Subsection III of the operating criteria pertaining to noise control. Specifically, we suggest more definitive provisions to replace the words "unusual or excessive noise" to insure that reasonably uniform application will be realized.
